scripts.build: npm run sync:canonical && vite build --outDir ../frontend/commerce-pro-preview --emptyOutDir && node scripts/verify-preview.mjs
scripts.build:integration: npm run sync:canonical && vite build --config vite.integration.config.mjs && node scripts/finalize-integration-preview.mjs
scripts.build:fixture: npm run sync:canonical && vite build --config vite.fixture.config.mjs
scripts.verify:integration: npm run build:integration && npm run test:integration
scripts.verify:cutover: npm run build:cutover && npm run test:cutover
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && npm run build:integration && npm test
